rv.q: Yes, this is a huge concert — not a full production.
It is dramatic, epic, and a glorious throwback to a time when budgets felt irrelevant.
Les Misérables: The Arena Concert Spectacular is a reminder of why this musical will continue to thrive for one decade more, and another, and another.
By almost every measure, the concert lives up to the challenge, delivering both the promised spectacle and the heartfelt humanity at its core.
You couldn’t ask for a better way to hear this glorious score.
Most important, the concert sounds glorious.
(It’s no surprise she played Whitney Houston on stage for over a year and is a reality TV veteran.) As expected, though, Marius and Cossette get the happy ending.
Between a cast of vocal powerhouses and sound design that turns Radio City into a cathedral, it's easy to forgive the clunky visuals and just let the score of Les Misérables take over.

cn.t: Critics praise this star-studded arena production as a thrilling celebration of the beloved mega-musical, with its massive orchestra and spectacular staging earning acclaim despite some finding the video screens and lasers excessive.

vr.q: I would recommend it to Everyone... You can't miss it. It really is that spectacular.
